Elizabeth's Vector Garden
=========================

Built with UGTS-KC 3.9.0 — KC Elizabeth.

Open index.html in a modern browser. The build is self-contained and does not require a network connection.
For browsers that restrict local-file features, run: python -m http.server 8000
Then open http://localhost:8000/ in the browser.

Default controls are defined in project.json. This build also exposes window.KCGame for pause, restart, save, load, state and diagnostics.
